approved_scope: publish Mitsubishi grade- and breaker-level cutting conditions as adjustable starting points
correct TS2 grade interpretation and set BF breaker
add exact BC8110 and BC8210 product-grade identities while preserving historical K provenance
decisions.notes: Greg explicitly stated that Mitsubishi breaker-level cutting conditions should be displayed as good starting points because Mitsubishi commonly retains cutting conditions across a breaker family and machinists adjust from the baseline. Greg also stated that his shop never cuts dry; profiles therefore select flood/wet while retaining Mitsubishi source wording that permits Dry or Wet.
